Read the following notes about planning a community garden.

A community garden provides fresh vegetables and a place for neighbors to work together. The organizers choose a sunny site, test the soil, arrange a reliable water supply, and divide the space into accessible beds. Volunteers share tools, keep a planting calendar, make compost, and check the plants regularly. Clear responsibilities and regular meetings help the project continue throughout the year.
